title: When is your birthday? The math behind hash collisions
summary: A technical blog post explaining the birthday paradox and its direct connection to hash collision vulnerabilities in cryptographic systems, demonstrating how probability mathematics underlies security weaknesses in hash functions.
problem_solved: Explains why hash collisions occur more frequently than intuition suggests, using the birthday paradox as an intuitive mathematical framework.
why_valuable: Provides developers and security professionals with the mathematical intuition needed to understand and mitigate hash collision attacks in real-world systems.
